title: Parkour Runner with Particle Effects
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with a Three.js parkour runner game featuring a stork character model and particle effects.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use Three.js with GLTFLoader from CDN (unpkg or jsdelivr)
- Create a perspective camera at position (0, 5, 12) looking toward the origin
- Add a directional light at (5, 10, 5) with intensity 1.0 and ambient light with intensity 0.4
- Load 'stork.glb' using GLTFLoader as the runner character. Scale it to (0.02, 0.02, 0.02) and place at initial position (0, 1, 0)
- If the model has animations, play the first animation using AnimationMixer
- Create a procedurally generated parkour course: a series of platform segments (boxes) that scroll toward the player. Each platform is 4 units wide, 0.5 units tall, and 6 units deep, colored in alternating shades of green (#44aa44 and #338833). Generate at least 10 platforms initially, spaced 6 units apart along the Z axis, starting at z=0 going negative
- Add gaps (missing platforms) randomly every 3-5 platforms
- Add obstacle blocks (red boxes, 0.8x1.5x0.8) on some platforms that the player must jump over
- Create a particle system with 200 particles using THREE.Points and BufferGeometry. Particles should trail behind the stork as speed particles (small white/cyan dots) that emit from the stork's position and fade out over 1 second

PHYSICS & MOVEMENT:
- The course scrolls toward the player at a base speed of 8 units/second, increasing by 0.5 units/sec every 10 seconds
- The stork has gravity: acceleration of -20 units/s², terminal velocity of -15 units/s
- The stork can move left/right between lanes: positions x = -3, 0, 3 (three lanes)
- Ground collision: when stork y <= platform top (1.25 = 0.5 height/2 + platform y center at 0.5), set velocity to 0 and snap to y=1.25, but only if a platform exists beneath
- If the stork falls below y = -5, trigger game over
- Collision with red obstacles also triggers game over

USER INTERACTIONS:
- SPACE or UP arrow: Jump. Apply upward velocity of 10 units/s. Only allow jumping when grounded (isGrounded === true)
- LEFT arrow or A key: Move one lane left (minimum x = -3)
- RIGHT arrow or D key: Move one lane right (maximum x = 3)
- A 'Start' button (id='startBtn') in the center of screen to begin the game
- A 'Restart' button (id='restartBtn') shown only on game over

PARTICLE EFFECTS:
- When jumping, emit a burst of 20 yellow particles from the stork's feet that spread downward
- Speed trail particles continuously emit from behind the stork (offset z+1) and move backward, fading alpha from 1 to 0
- On game over, emit 50 red particles in an explosion pattern from the stork's position

SCORING & HUD:
- Display score (id='scoreDisplay') in top-left corner, white text, font-size 24px. Score increases by 1 for each platform successfully passed
- Display current speed (id='speedDisplay') below score
- Display 'GAME OVER' text (id='gameOverText') centered on screen when game ends, initially hidden
- Show particle count (id='particleCount') in top-right corner

STATE MANAGEMENT - expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- gameState: 'menu' | 'playing' | 'gameover'
- score: number (platforms passed)
- storkPosition: {x, y, z} current stork position
- storkVelocityY: number, current vertical velocity
- isGrounded: boolean
- currentLane: -1 | 0 | 1 (left, center, right)
- currentSpeed: number (scroll speed)
- jumpCount: number (total jumps performed)
- particlesActive: number (currently visible particles)
- platformCount: number (total platforms in scene)
- obstacleCount: number (total obstacles in scene)
- elapsedTime: number (seconds since game start)
- modelLoaded: boolean (true when stork.glb is loaded)
- lastCollisionType: 'none' | 'obstacle' | 'fall'

Update __3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop.
physics_constraints: Gravity: -20 units/s². Jump velocity: 10 units/s. Terminal velocity: -15 units/s. Ground level at y=1.25 when on platform. Lane positions: x in {-3, 0, 3}. Base scroll speed: 8 units/s, increasing 0.5/s every 10 seconds. Fall death at y < -5.
